dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sorry, I don't understand. Slowly, please.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˌʌndərˈstænd. ˈsloʊli, ˈpliːz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Oh, sorry! Where are you from?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ˈsɑːri! ˈwɛr ər juː ˈfrʌm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm from Thailand. I speak a little English.
dialogue.reading: aɪm frəm ˈtaɪlænd. aɪ ˈspiːk ə ˈlɪtəl ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ.
